title: Synthetic Pair Construction
description: Begins with a plain-language explanation of corruption transforms and factuality labels, then traces the corresponding implementation and its limits in abstractive-text-summarizer.
learning_objectives: Explain corruption transforms and factuality labels in plain language and connect it to data_generation/create_data.py; data_generation/augmentation_ops.py.
Trace one input through the synthetic pair construction stage and identify its output and assumptions.
Diagnose one failure mode or limitation before extending this stage.
prerequisites: Read project prerequisites and the previous module when present.
practical_outcomes: Trace the synthetic pair construction stage through the cited source paths.
Produce a small test or diagnostic for corruption transforms and factuality labels.
completion_criteria: Complete the three lessons and exercise.
Answer all ten module questions using material from these lessons.
Submit a short source citation and limitation note.
